card.text: Explore Pandora with Cassini imagery, mapped radial height and its measured irregular shape.

introduction.text: Pandora is an irregular icy moon just outside Saturn’s F ring. Its gravity disturbs the ring, and Cassini revealed grooves, ridges and craters softened by a coating of fine debris.

normal.title: ISS mosaic
normal.summary: Brightness matching reduces photographed shading. The gray grid marks missing coverage and terrain hidden in cast shadows.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 40.6 km sphere, from the Cassini shape model. Small craters are unresolved.
